evals.name: vague-feature-intake
evals.prompt: I want users of my SaaS dashboard to be able to upload files and have an AI summarise them. Help me plan this out.
evals.expected_output: Plays back understanding in plain language and waits for confirmation before anything else; then asks batched clarifying questions with recommended answers; does not write files before module breakdown is approved.

evals.name: detailed-spec-to-modules
evals.prompt: Plan this: multi-tenant invoicing. Postgres, one schema per tenant. Invoices are created from approved timesheets, PDFs rendered async by a worker queue and stored in S3 (private, presigned URLs). Stripe for payment with webhooks; retries with exponential backoff, max 5. Roles: admin, accountant, viewer. Expect 50k invoices/month. Overdue reminders at 7 and 14 days by email.
evals.expected_output: Plays back, asks only about real gaps (e.g. tax, currency, failure handling), proposes several modules with clear ownership, then writes modules, decisions.md and tasks; check.py passes with no errors.

evals.name: update-contradicting-decision
evals.prompt: The upload limit should be 100 MB now, not 25 MB. Update the plan.
evals.expected_output: Runs impact analysis, adds a new decision superseding D-003 rather than editing it, edits only the owning section, checks dependents link rather than restate, flags or adds tasks, and check.py passes.

evals.name: cluttered-docs-cleanup
evals.prompt: Our docs folder is a mess, different files say different things about the same features. Clean it up.
evals.expected_output: Starts with a read-only inventory and asks what ambiguous folders/files mean; extracts claims to a ledger; presents conflicts for the user to decide instead of resolving them; makes no changes before mapping approval.
